title: Profiling gate and metric contract for precision model variants
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a deterministic gating and metric contract for new quantization profile artifacts (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ) so that model onboarding and version pinning can publish profiles with measurable, machine-readable guarantees. This ticket standardizes the validation pipeline, the canary telemetry signals consumed by the console and runtime, and the publishing metadata required by the artifact registry. The goal is to prevent silent perf regressions when a quant profile is used in hosted/dedicated/private deployments and to enable automated rollback/fallback with well-defined thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A profile artifact schema (v1) exists and is validated by CI: includes model version, quant backend, calibration seed, tokenization fingerprint, golden prompt-set hash, latency/throughput baselines, and accuracy deltas on canonical eval sets.

A gated CI job (quant-gate) rejects profile artifacts that deviate beyond thresholds for core metrics (p50 latency increase > 25ms OR token throughput drop > 15% OR quality regressions > 1.5% on primary eval) unless marked as experimental.
Runtime can read profile metadata and map to fallback model variants when thresholds are exceeded at runtime (automated policy + console visible decision trace).
Console shows per-profile telemetry and a pass/fail signal for canary rollouts; PM and SRE can sign off before release to production tenants.
A documented rollback/mitigation playbook is added to the onboarding runbook and linked from the profile artifact page.
changes: Add profile schema validator to quant-profile CI (python utility added in ci/quant/validate_profile.py).
New canary job in GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/quant-canary.yml that runs perf and accuracy checks against the golden prompt set and synthetic throughput harness.
Runtime: expose a lightweight metadata reader and threshold evaluator in the admission path (C++/Rust change; feature-flagged).
Console: new UI tile and API endpoint to display profile status and per-metric time series (console-service + console-ui PRs).
Telemetry: harmonize metric names and labels for quant families (quant.backend, quant.format, profile.version) and emit a profile_pass boolean signal for canary windows.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): land CI validator and schema and run against existing profiles in staging. Target window: 3 days.
Phase 2 (canary): enable gated release for 20% of new profile publishes and surface results in the console. Collect telemetry for 7 days.
Phase 3 (gradual): increase publish acceptance to 100% after two canary cycles with no regressions and sign-off from SRE and PM.

Fallback strategy: if runtime observes sustained metric violation for a profile, automatically route requests to the pinned baseline model variant and notify owners via Slack and the console alerting system.
test_plan: Unit tests for schema validator with positive and negative vectors.
Integration test: publish a synthetic profile and verify CI gate behaviour in ephemeral environment.
E2E canary test: run canary publish against staging runtime and check fallback triggers when we inject latency/accuracy regressions.
Load test: use the throughput harness to ensure INT8 and GPTQ profiles do not regress token/sec by more than 15% under standard batching distributions.
Regression suite: add two new golden prompt sets (dialogue_short, long_document_summarize) that run automatically against every profile publish.
